claims.claim_text: RESULT-001 executed the integrated OIC-ZTL-OAM chain end to end under one owner authorization.
claims.precedence_note: An owner-established claim about this execution.

claims.claim_text: MEASURED_INTERNAL_END_TO_END_TECHNICAL_DEMONSTRATION is ESTABLISHED, bounded to the frozen scenario, implementation commit and kernel pin.
claims.precedence_note: The owner-established measured claim.

claims.claim_text: Case 1 measured ZTL EARNED/T, epistemic ESTABLISHED, currentness CURRENT/G1, authority A1, institutional AUTHORIZED, runtime ALLOW, ACTION_PERMITTED, reliance ISSUED.
claims.precedence_note: A measured observation.

claims.claim_text: Case 2 measured currentness SUPERSEDED/G2 with epistemic ESTABLISHED unchanged.
claims.precedence_note: Reinforced against the manuscript on one side and for it on another: RW031 shows the compliance family does NOT model rule lifecycle, while RW027 pins a policy snapshot and RW028 names the check-to-use gap. Narrow to the gate-ordering property.

claims.claim_text: In case 2 authority was not evaluated; the record carries authority_evaluated false with reason CURRENTNESS_GATE_DID_NOT_PROCEED.
claims.precedence_note: SURVIVES and is now strengthened. The authoritative CMF taxonomy of business-process compliance has no functionality for a rule left unevaluated because an upstream gate stopped the path; CMF9 gives root cause of a VIOLATION. All four contemporary agent-governance sources return zero hits for not-evaluated/skipped/short-circuit.

claims.claim_text: Case 3 measured authority A10 (AUTHORITY_BASIS_REVOKED) with currentness CURRENT/G1 and epistemic ESTABLISHED.
claims.precedence_note: Unchanged; CT adds revocation context.

claims.claim_text: Case 4 measured authority A6, institutional UNRESOLVED, runtime ESCALATE, decision basis PRECAUTIONARY, epistemic ESTABLISHED.
claims.precedence_note: Mandato's PERMIT/ESCALATE/DENY and Five-Plane's argument for richer outcomes both narrow this further, though Mandato is planned and its ESCALATE is oversight routing.

claims.claim_text: Case 5 measured ZTL REFUTED/F and epistemic REFUTED while currentness was CURRENT/G1 and the authority basis passed with A1; the composed institutional_authorization_status was nonetheless REFUSED.
claims.precedence_note: A measured observation about case 5.

claims.claim_text: Case 5 records a distinct kernel evaluation under the v2 marking, with input and output identities different from case 1.
claims.precedence_note: A measured observation about case 5.

claims.claim_text: Reliance was issued in exactly one of five cases.
claims.precedence_note: Proof of Execution issues an Execution Attestation Certificate ONLY when PoE=1 — evaluation strictly gating issuance, in a measured implementation. That is the RESULT-001 ordering, and it moves R010 from a narrowing recommendation to explicit precedent. Cite RW027 alongside RW012.

claims.claim_text: Cases 2-5 each carry a persisted reason for the absence of a reliance record.
claims.precedence_note: Recording a reason for a non-produced outcome has an analogue in ETSI sub-indications.

claims.claim_text: Case-1 reliance was issued by a separate operating-system process under a different principal after sixteen frozen consumer checks passed.
claims.precedence_note: Separate downstream checking is preceded many times over; the term remains SEPARATE, not independent.

claims.claim_text: The case-1 separate consumer re-resolved currentness and re-evaluated authority before issuance, evidenced by frozen consumer checks 13 and 15 and the recorded re-resolution and reliance-time authority digests.
claims.precedence_note: SURVIVES the decisive test. PoE full text has zero hits for re-verify/re-evaluate/re-resolve. RW028's re-verification is retrospective third-party inspection of the log. Mandato's independent verifier checks log integrity. None re-resolves rule currentness AND re-evaluates authority before issuing a reliance-bearing artifact.

claims.claim_text: The demo-specific OAMDecision composition record carries epistemic_status, institutional_authorization_status, execution_disposition and decision_basis as four separately represented fields that are not semantically interchangeable.
claims.precedence_note: Five-Plane argues with a measured core that Boolean allow/deny is structurally insufficient and enumerates richer outcomes. The four-field claim must be narrowed to the specific set including a typed decision_basis and a preserved epistemic field.

claims.claim_text: The kernel-derived epistemic_status is preserved as its own field and is not rewritten by a currentness or authority outcome; the other three fields are composed outputs and the composition reads an appropriate-epistemic-route component alongside currentness, authority and the other control components.
claims.precedence_note: KeyNote's advice/enforcement split remains the precedent; ETSI adds a structured status upstream of the relying decision.

claims.claim_text: Authority is not a ZTL ground; the evaluated formula names only the amount and evidence grounds.
